name: Plainstrider Beak
summary: Across the Barrens, hunters bring Plainstrider Beaks to the Crossroads as proof that threatening birds have been culled.

sections.title: A Measure of the Hunt
sections.body: Plainstriders forage near the Crossroads and threaten its supplies. Greater, fleeting, and ornery plainstriders roam the surrounding savannah. Sergra Darkthorn asks arriving hunters to bring back their beaks, proof that the flocks have been driven from supply lines and storehouses.

faq.q: Why does Sergra Darkthorn want Plainstrider Beaks?
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn asks hunters to cull plainstriders because the birds harass food supplies around the Crossroads. Their beaks show the threat to local supplies has been reduced.
Hunters take the beaks from greater, fleeting, and ornery plainstriders roaming the Barrens savannah.

faq.q: Why don't all plainstriders provide a beak when slain?
faq.answer: Swift, thrashing plainstriders can leave a beak cracked, shattered, or unusable as a clean trophy in the struggle. Hunters gather only intact beaks.

angles.text: As a hunter, you stalk plainstriders across Kalimdor’s open plains and gather their beaks, learning to secure your prey.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect the trade and supply routes that feed the outpost by culling nuisance flocks east of the Crossroads.
